integrity: The exact operator norms are proved from the circulant kernel and explicit equality witnesses. The asymptotics are derived by harmonic-number expansion and midpoint Euler--Maclaurin; the bundled numerical checker is corroborative rather than a substitute for those proofs.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the canonical cyclic Hilbert sign multiplier at the endpoint exponents. It does not determine sharp intermediate-exponent norms and does not claim novelty for the elementary finite sine-sum kernel formulas in isolation.
title: Exact endpoint norm and dyadic parity law for the cyclic Hilbert transform
